definitions.explanation: Describes something designed or suitable for many different purposes. Commonly used to describe rooms, facilities, and equipment.

examples.japanese: {多目的|たもくてき}⟦ホール→ホール：11169_hooru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A meeting was held in the multipurpose hall.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多目的|たもくてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: This room can be used for multiple purposes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多目的|たもくてき}⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦されていて→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{車椅子|くるまいす}→車椅子：10533_kurumaisu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}できる→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The station has multipurpose restrooms that can also be used by wheelchair users.

notes:
USAGE:
Very commonly seen on signs in public facilities. {多目的|たもくてき}⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧ (multipurpose/accessible restroom) is one of the most frequent uses, referring to restrooms with accessibility features for wheelchair users, parents with small children, and ostomates.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多目的|たもくてき}⟦ホール→ホール：11169_hooru⟧ (multipurpose hall)
- {多目的|たもくてき}⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧ (multipurpose/accessible restroom)
- {多目的|たもくてき}ルーム (multipurpose room)
- {多目的|たもくてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use for multiple purposes)
